description: This file contains the implementation of ContentItemDisplayCoordinator, a class responsible for coordinating the display, editing, and updating of content items within OrchardCore CMS. It manages content parts, fields, and their associated display drivers, shapes, and placement logic.

classes.name: ContentItemDisplayCoordinator
classes.description: A class that handles the coordination of content item display, editing, and updating by invoking appropriate drivers and managing shape creation and placement.

methods.name: BuildDisplayAsync
methods.description: Builds the display shape for a content item by invoking display drivers and assembling shapes for parts and fields.

methods.name: BuildEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds the editor shape for a content item, including parts and fields, allowing for content editing.

methods.name: UpdateEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates the editor shape for a content item, processing user input and applying changes.

methods.name: CreateShapeResult
methods.description: Creates a shape result for a content part, setting up alternates and placement details.
